```{r}
set.seed(123)
```


```{r}
# Cargar librerías
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r}
source("../scripts/modeling_utils_tidymodels_clean.R")
```

```{r}
# Cargamos los datasets procesados
train <- readRDS("../data/processed/support2/df2/train_base.rds")
valid <- readRDS("../data/processed/support2/df2/valid_base.rds")
test <- readRDS("../data/processed/support2/df2/test_base.rds")
```

```{r}
resultado_tech <- entrenar_benchmark(
  train_data = train,
  valid_data = valid,
  test_data = test,
  nombre_dataset = "df2_Tech",
  usar_cv = TRUE,
  folds = 5,
  grid_size = 10,
  clase_positiva = "Yes"
)

resultados_validacion <- resultado_tech$validation
resultados_test <- resultado_tech$test
mejor_configuracion <- resultado_tech$best_params
```

```{r}
resultados_validacion %>%
  kbl(digits = 3) %>% 
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "bordered"), 
    full_width = FALSE, 
    position = "left"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "#2c3e50", background = "#eaedf1")
mejor_configuracion %>%
  kbl() %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "bordered"), 
    full_width = FALSE, 
    position = "left"
  )

generar_graficos_automaticos(resultados_validacion)
```

```{r}
resultados_test %>%
  kbl(digits = 3) %>% 
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "bordered"), 
    full_width = FALSE, 
    position = "left"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "#2c3e50", background = "#eaedf1")
```

```{r}
plot_roc_comparativo(resultado_tech$validation_fits, valid, "ROC: Validacion - df2_Tech")
plot_roc_comparativo(list(Best = resultado_tech$best_fit), test, "ROC: Test Final - df2_Tech")
```
